thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — PD-78921. Service: hosted-api.us-west-2 /v1/generate p99 latency > 2s and elevated error rate. Customers affected: multiple. Please acknowledge and claim.
amy: acked — oncall amy here, stepping in. pulling up dashboards and traces.
sam: I see a sharp increase in queue depth on embedding-proxy and GPU worker OOMs around 11:03. tailing logs now.
tess: any recent deploys to runtime or autoscaler? thinking autoscaler lag or kernel change.
dmitri: no deploys to autoscaler in last hour. logs show repeated `KVCache::alloc` OOMs on worker-23/24. stack snippets: `at runtime::kernel_select()` then OOM.
omar: starting warm GPU instances in dedicated pool (eu-west->us-west cross-region warmup). will force additional nodes up and route traffic.
amy: enabling temporary routing fallback to smaller model for latency-sensitive routes: `route.apply(fallback_model='redwood-7b-quant', threshold_ms=1000)` — doing this only for public hosted tier to limit customer impact.
sam: initiating rollback of last runtime change (revert commit 4f2a9) — creating PR and will merge if CI green.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: acknowledged by amy. Escalation paused.
tess: @support-team can you prepare proactive comms for top affected customers (IDs list in ops/alerts)? we should post a status page update.
support-team: nina taking this, drafting message to top 5 customers and a status page blurb. will paste draft here in a minute.
dmitri: quick grep: the kernel selection path chooses a high-memory kernel for seq_len>2048 on a subset of Ampere nodes, but mem accounting is off for quantized models — reproducing locally. opening runtime issue INF-2048 and early hotfix branch.
omar: autoscaler policy bumped (min_replicas +2, scale_cooldown shorter) to absorb burst. warming new pods now.
amy: traffic routed to fallback model; p95 down from 1.9s -> 720ms, p99 trending down. errors per minute falling.
sam: rollback merged and runtime hotfix PR created by dmitri. CI green, scheduling deploy to canary slots.
incident-bot: deploy-bot: canary deploy queued for runtime-hotfix to 10% traffic.
amy: monitoring traces, KV cache errors decreasing on canary. continuing observation.
support-team: nina: status page updated: "Degradation affecting hosted API in US-WEST. Mitigations underway; partial fallback routing applied. Updates every 15 minutes." draft to customers ready and queued.
tess: adding postmortem owner: dmitri + amy's oncall notes. please include affected customer list and timeline.
dmitri: capturing logs and repro; will include kernel-selection regression details and test to prevent recurring.
amy: if stable for 15m we'll close the pager. currently 12m with steady p99 < 800ms.
sam: agreed. leaving watch for 30m then close.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-78921 acknowledged by amy at 1765450032.
omar: new instances fully warmed, tail health checks look green. no further OOM spikes on the warmers.
nina: customer comms sent to top 5, support ticket templates created for inbound asks.
amy: merging final runtime hotfix to main and starting rollout to remaining traffic.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD-78921 closed by amy at 1765451375.
amy: incident resolved — root cause: runtime kernel selection regression causing OOMs under certain sequence lengths on Ampere nodes; mitigation: fallback routing + autoscaler and runtime rollback/hotfix. follow-up: INF-2048 assigned to dmitri for long-term fix and automated test. will create postmortem and stakeholder comms. :thumbsup:
sam: thanks team — great quick coordination.
tess: filing postmortem template now. closing channel for updates, will reopen if regression seen.
support-team: nina: monitoring customer replies, will escalate any urgent asks to oncall.
amy: closing watch but leaving alerts at warning level for next 24h. good job everyone.
